implementation_ontology.algorithm: Load source16x8x4spin tile plusperiodic6-facehalo into1080Int32sharedslots. implementation_ontology.work_item_mapping: Logicalthread(tx0..15,ty0..3,tz0..3), group(bx0..1,by0..1,bz0..7). Eachthreadowns two spins andonePCGstate. Sourceblockscheckerboard preventadjacentactiveblocks. JACC physical(16,16)flattenlocaly=tz*4+ty andgridy=bz*2+by, preservingnativewarp-linearorder.
implementation_ontology.layout: FlatInt32spin/H[C(x,y,z)], shared[(z+1)*180+(y+1)*18+x+1],1080slots4320B. PCGtid=z*256+(by*4+ty)*32+x. Eachfullfieldbuffer8guards/side, input/afterecho repeatedsamephysicalguards, UInt64lossless2xUInt32wordencoding.

scientific_intent.scientific_task: Advance a periodic three-dimensional nearest-neighbor Ising spin configuration by seeded Metropolis proposals under a spatial magnetic field.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Hamiltonian E=-sum_<ij>s_i*s_j-h*sum_i H_i*s_i. Propose spin sign reversal with ΔE=2*s_i*(sum_6neighbors s_j+h*H_i), accept if ΔE<=0 or u<exp(-beta*ΔE), B=-2beta. PCG XSH-RR state advances for every proposal, even unconditional acceptance.
scientific_intent.discretization: Periodic L32 cubic volume32768spins, two-level block checkerboard with source logical16x4x4threads/16x8x4spin tiles and one white/black update peractiveblock. alt0+alt1 is a full sweep, threecases with2/1/3 sweeps; sourceBLOCK_STEPS1.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Exact every spin,64bit PCGstate/inc, actualinitialinputecho andguards against independent direct-global-neighbor CPU oracle andbothGPUrefs. SourceFloat32uniformrounding exactlyretained; Float64probability CPUoracle, decisionmargins frozen beforeGPU. Zero-beta/h0 analyticalcontrol inverts everyspin afterodd3sweeps.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: Three L32 fullspin-update component cases, nonuniformH/h.5/beta.25, uniformH/h.125/beta.125, beta0control. Doesnotinclude complete replicaexchange/temperatureadaptation CLI, seeding/randomfieldgeneration orGPUenergyreduction.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Spin/H Int32, PCGstate/incUInt64 modulo2^64, outputXSH-RRUInt32, Float32uniform/deltaH/exp. h/B dyadic makes selected deltaH/probabilityarguments exactF32; independentFloat64exp withstrictrecordeddecisionmargins makesacceptancewellseparated. Stateencodedaslow/high32bitF64words, noUInt64loss.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Source trueke byCristobal A.Navarro andWeiHuang2015 targets exchange Monte Carlo. The measured corrected spin-update component is relevant to classical statistical mechanics sampling, but no equilibrium observable, mixing, thermalization, phase-transition or fullparalleltempering accuracy is established.
